meta.description: Orchestrates the untargeted LC-MS metabolomics pipeline end-to-end (xcms 4.x feature extraction, QC/drift/normalization, confidence-stratified annotation, permutation-validated statistics, background-aware pathway mapping), naming what each stage decides and where it silently fails.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated DOI/PMID/p-values/effect sizes anywhere; every number reported (90/172 samples dropped, pR2Y=pQ2=0.001/0.014, real KEGG pathway p-values) came from real xcms/pmp/ropls/KEGGREST output on real faahKO/MTBLS79 data or clearly-labeled synthetic examples.

practice_boundaries.detail: Research-only mouse/serum/synthetic metabolomics pipeline; no individual diagnostic or prescriptive claims, no medical-disclaimer-requiring content.

methodological_ground.detail: No principled statistical fallacy found; drop-wholly-NA-then-impute-sparse-rest ('report and drop, don't fabricate') is methodologically sound, and the newly-coded MSI-gate/mode-lock enforce exactly the commitments the Skill states.

code_usability.detail: RE-AUDIT: 7 of 9 inputs were real code execution (up from 3 of 7 pre-fix). Both P1 crashes found pre-fix (Stage1->2 orientation, Stage2->4 imputation) are verified fixed on the exact same real data. Both previously-unenforced governing commitments (Input 4 MSI-gate, Input 6 mode-lock) now have real, executing code, including correct behavior on adversarial edge cases (all-tentative refusal, missing-mode hard stop).

functional_suitability.note: RE-AUDIT: both pre-fix correctness defects (Stage1->2 orientation inversion, Stage2->4 crash) are fixed and verified on real data. Remaining gap: the MS-DIAL alternate entry point (Input 5) still has zero glue code, unchanged from pre-fix and not part of this fix batch.

reliability.note: Common Errors table now documents both fixed bugs plus the new QRILC-wipeout and empty-identified_compounds failure modes with concrete fixes -- a real improvement over the pre-fix table, which omitted both hand-off bugs it should have caught.

performance_context.note: Grew from 230 to ~310 lines adding the fixes, but still defers detail to component Skills well; token cost is proportionate to the added correctness.

agent_usability.note: The prose/code consistency gap that cost points pre-fix (governing commitments narrated but not coded) is closed: mode-lock and MSI-gate are now both stated AND executable.

human_usability.note: QC Checkpoint and Common Errors tables are noticeably more actionable post-fix, naming the exact drop-then-impute and MSI-filter steps a human would need to verify.

security.note: No credential exposure, injection vectors, or destructive operations anywhere in the orchestration code; the new Stage 5 code explicitly prefers the no-remote-call Local-Only ORA path when the primary path is rejected.

maintainability.note: The bundled example gap flagged pre-fix (P2) is closed: examples/pipeline_handoff_check.R now exercises real pmp+ropls calls across the exact seams that broke. Still no bundled example runs a real Stage 1 xcms extraction end-to-end into Stage 2 -- deliberately deferred to xcms-preprocessing's own scope per the fix log.

agent_specific.note: The escape-hatch gap flagged pre-fix (Input 2's crash had no recovery guidance) is closed: wholly-NA samples are now reported by batch and dropped rather than crashing or being silently fabricated, and stopifnot guards fire predictably at every new hand-off.

inputs.label: Ionization-mode lock (governing commitment #1), now real executing code (regression + upgrade of pre-fix Input 6)
inputs.note: Pre-fix this was inspection-only (PARTIAL): no per-feature mode column existed anywhere. Post-fix code (`defs$mode <- ionization_mode; stopifnot(!anyNA(defs$mode)); if (length(unique(defs$mode)) > 1) by_mode <- split(defs, defs$mode)`) run against single-mode, mixed-mode (12 positive/8 negative), and missing-mode synthetic tables: single-mode case needs no split, mixed-mode case correctly splits into 2 internally-homogeneous groups, and a missing mode correctly hard-stops rather than being silently inferred.

key_strengths: Both pre-fix P1 crashes (Stage1->2 orientation inversion, Stage2->4 unimputed-NA opls() crash) are verified fixed on the exact same real MTBLS79/faahKO data used pre-fix, reproducing the fix log's own claimed numbers exactly (90/172 dropped, pR2Y=pQ2=0.001).

The two previously-unenforced governing commitments (MSI-confidence gate, ionization mode-lock) now have real, executing code, including correct behavior on adversarial edge cases (all-tentative refusal, missing-mode hard stop, mixed-mode split).

A new second bundled example (pipeline_handoff_check.R) exercises the real pmp+ropls seam end-to-end on data shaped like the real failure, closing the pre-fix P2 finding that the one bundled example never touched real multi-package hand-offs.

Live cross-Skill consistency verified: Stage 5's MSI-gated output hands off with zero adaptation into pathway-mapping's independently-audited Local-Only ORA code (92/Production Ready), reproducing that Skill's own background-inflation finding on a real KEGGREST pull.
No credential, injection, or destructive-operation exposure anywhere; the Stage 5 code explicitly documents and prefers the no-remote-call path when the primary MetaboAnalystR API path is rejected.

recommendations.title: MS-DIAL alternate entry point still has zero glue code
recommendations.problem: The orchestrator still claims 'import the alignment-result table and enter the pipeline at Stage 2' with no code demonstrating the hand-off, unchanged from the pre-fix audit.
recommendations.root_cause: msdial-preprocessing was not part of this round's fix batch, so this pointer was left as prose.
recommendations.fix: Add a short code snippet showing msdial-preprocessing's Alignment ID/Area export feeding directly into filter_peaks_by_fraction, mirroring the level of detail Stage 1's xcms entry point now has.

recommendations.title: impute.QRILC has no explicit seed, so exact imputed values are not run-to-run reproducible
recommendations.problem: Re-running Stage 2's Input 2 code on the identical real MTBLS79 data produced a different minimum imputed value (17.155 here vs 11.77 in the fixer's own verification run) -- same non-negative, NA-free outcome and identical downstream model-fit statistics (pR2Y=pQ2=0.001), but the imputed values themselves vary.
recommendations.root_cause: imputeLCMD's impute.QRILC draws from a fitted distribution and is not seeded by the Stage 2 code block, unlike PerformPSEA elsewhere in the same pipeline which does call set.seed(123).
recommendations.fix: Add set.seed() immediately before the impute.QRILC call in Stage 2, matching the explicit seeding convention already used for PerformPSEA.

recommendations.title: No bundled example runs a real Stage 1 xcms extraction into the rest of the pipeline
recommendations.problem: Both bundled examples start from a synthetic or cached featureValues()-shaped table; neither exercises real mzML -> xcms -> Stage 2 as part of one script.
recommendations.root_cause: Deliberately deferred by the fixer (fix log 'Left unfixed') to xcms-preprocessing's own bundled-example scope, since it needs real instrument files.
recommendations.fix: A future third example chaining real (or cached) xcms output through all 5 stages would give full-pipeline regression coverage, but is reasonably out of scope for this fix round.
